title: Normalized pure sections generate the affine iterated pullback sections.
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module, $U,W$ affine objects of its small etale site, $g:W\to U$ a morphism, and $n\in\mathbf N$. Put $P=W\times_U\cdots\times_U W$ with $n+1$ factors, $M=\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$, and $\rho:M\to\Gamma(P,P^*\mathcal F)$ the unit-normalized tensor restriction of [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Then the sections $(\prod_k\pi_k^*b_k)\rho(m)$, for $m\in M$ and $b_k\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O_W)$, generate the additive group $\Gamma(P,P^*\mathcal F)$.

source.place: Tag 03P2, affine tensor calculation, using Tags 01I4, 01JQ, 01I9, 01IA

proof.text: Apply singletonProduct_affine_ring to obtain affineness of P and an A-linear equivalence e from the indexed tensor power to Gamma(P,O), with e(tprod(b)) equal to the product of projection pullbacks.

Apply exists_etaleAffineTensorSectionsEquiv to the morphism P to U, giving an additive equivalence c from M tensor Gamma(P,O) to Gamma(P,P*F) with c(m tensor z)=z rho(m). Compose c with TensorProduct.congr(refl,e) to obtain E. Its pure-generator equation follows by rewriting the two displayed normalization equations.

The private tensor_generators_span proves additive generation for any additive equivalence E with this pure-generator equation. By surjectivity write a section as E(t). TensorProduct.induction_on reduces membership in the closure to zero, sums and m tensor b. PiTensorProduct.induction_on reduces b to sums and r times tprod(b). Additivity handles sums; balancing moves r to m; the normalization identifies the remaining image with an element of the generating range. Thus top is contained in the closure.

theorem singletonTensorSections_span
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let P := ∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range (fun p :
      Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤) × (Fin (n + 1) → Γ(W.left, ⊤)) ↦
        (∏ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g) k).left.left.appTop (p.2 k)) •
            Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F P.hom p.1)) = ⊤
